nodes.label: Empty-State / Error-State UI Pattern
nodes.rationale: A single `.empty-state` block - Bootstrap icon, short heading, muted sentence, optional recovery action - serves both the HTTP error pages and the {% empty %} branch of every list table. Reusing one visual idiom means a zero-row table and a server fault read as the same class of 'nothing to show here' event, so users learn one recovery affordance. The error partial is parameterised by code/head/msg and injected into both auth_content and content blocks so it renders correctly whether or not the visitor is authenticated.
